title: Week x ranked topic: how many distinct outlets carry it, and how concentrated it is
description: BigQuery radar.topic_sources_weekly from radar.article_segment (ring 1, the org/thm ids of topic_daily, Monday weeks) -> lake/gold/topic_sources_weekly.parquet. WS4 uses it to keep wire-syndication bursts (one outlet or one feed repeated across sites) out of the top 10.

week.description: Monday of the ISO week, as edges_weekly

n_articles.description: distinct ring-1 articles of the week mentioning the topic

top_source_share.description: share of the articles from the single largest source

top3_source_share.description: share from the three largest sources

top_theme_pattern_share.description: share of the articles carrying the week's most common exact set of the topic's top co-mentioned entities (a syndicated-copy signal); null if not computed
